title: Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems: A Next-Generation Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating Large Language Models and Agents on RTL Design and Verification
authors_zh: Nathaniel Pinckney、Chenhui Deng、Chia-Tung Ho、Yun-Da Tsai、Mingjie Liu、Wenfei Zhou、Brucek Khailany、Haoxing Ren
paper_type_zh: Verilog RTL 设计与验证基准
best_for_zh: 研究硬件设计代理、RTL 生成、验证和调试的研究者。
one_line: CVDP releases 783 engineer-authored RTL generation, verification, and debugging problems with tool-backed evaluation for models and agents.
CVDP 发布覆盖 RTL 生成、验证与调试的 783 个工程师编写问题，以工具执行和评分基础设施评测模型与代理。
why: CVDP releases 783 engineer-authored RTL generation, verification, and debugging problems with tool-backed evaluation for models and agents.
inclusion_reason: CVDP 发布覆盖 RTL 生成、验证与调试的 783 个工程师编写问题，以工具执行和评分基础设施评测模型与代理。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing Verilog benchmarks focus mainly on short RTL completion or specification-to-code generation, with narrow task coverage and some subsets approaching saturation. They rarely include testbenches, assertions, debugging, code improvement, module reuse, or agentic workflows requiring multiple tool interactions. Consequently, model capability across the broader hardware-design and verification lifecycle cannot be measured consistently.

CVDP uses expert-authored tasks from multiple categories and provides repositories, tools, reference solutions, and executable validation infrastructure for both non-agentic and agentic settings.

现有 Verilog benchmark 多集中于短 RTL 补全或 specification-to-code，任务类型单一，部分已被强模型接近解决；它们很少覆盖 testbench、assertion、调试、代码改进、模块复用和需要多轮工具操作的 agentic 流程。结果是模型在完整硬件设计与验证生命周期中的能力无法被统一测量。

CVDP 由硬件工程师编写多类别真实任务，并为非代理和代理设置提供仓库、工具、参考实现和可执行验证基础设施。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CVDP retains 783 tasks authored by experienced hardware engineers across 13 categories of RTL design, verification, debugging, specification alignment, and technical question answering. Of these, 617 are non-agentic and 166 are agentic. A problem may include a multi-file repository, natural-language specification, existing RTL or testbench, reference outcome, and tool configuration. Code tasks are checked by compilation and simulation, while comprehension tasks combine automatic metrics and judging. It is a broad evaluation benchmark rather than a large SFT corpus.

CVDP 最终保留 783 个由资深硬件工程师编写的任务，覆盖 13 类 RTL 设计、验证、调试、规格对齐和技术问答；其中 617 个为 non-agentic，166 个为 agentic。一个问题可对应多文件仓库、自然语言规格、已有 RTL/testbench、参考结果和工具配置。代码任务由编译与仿真检查，理解任务结合自动指标和 judge。它是广覆盖 benchmark，不是专门为 SFT 构建的大规模训练集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Category definition: Thirteen task categories are defined across the hardware lifecycle, including generation, modification, debugging, verification, and comprehension.
  2. Expert authoring: Engineers write 1,313 candidates with specifications, context files, reference solutions, and required tools.
  3. Dual-mode packaging: Short tasks become single-turn non-agentic inputs, while tasks requiring file browsing, simulation, or iterative edits become agentic repositories.
  4. Quality filtering: Reference solutions must pass and incomplete contexts must fail; ambiguous, invalid, or overly easy problems are removed, leaving 783.
  5. Execution evaluation: RTL and testbenches are compiled and simulated, while comprehension tasks use BLEU or an LLM judge. Images, EDA tools, and benchmark versions must be fixed.

1. 定义类别：按硬件生命周期划分 13 类任务，覆盖生成、修改、调试、验证和理解。
  2. 专家出题：工程师编写 1,313 个候选，提供规格、上下文文件、参考方案及必要工具。
  3. 双模式封装：短任务整理为单轮 non-agentic 输入；需浏览文件、调用仿真或迭代修改者整理为 agentic 仓库。
  4. 质量过滤：确认参考方案通过、残缺上下文失败，并删除歧义、无效或过易问题，最终保留 783 项。
  5. 执行评测：RTL 与 testbench 经编译/仿真，理解任务另用 BLEU 或 LLM judge。镜像、EDA 工具和 benchmark 版本必须固定。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors evaluate multiple frontier and open models and find that no model exceeds 34% pass@1 on code-generation tasks, with module reuse, testbench construction, assertion generation, and debugging especially difficult. Data cleaning provides controlled evidence: only 783 of 1,313 authored candidates remain after an overall filtering rate of about 40.4%, and pass@1 rises in most categories after filtering, indicating that invalid or ambiguous tasks reduce interpretability. This supports benchmark difficulty and quality control, but some comprehension tasks use an LLM judge and are not as deterministic as compilation or simulation results.

作者评测多种前沿与开源模型，结论是任一模型在代码生成任务上的 pass@1 都不超过 34%，尤其 module reuse、testbench、assertion 和 debugging 较难。数据清洗也提供受控证据：1,313 个候选经约 40.4% 总体过滤后只保留 783 个，表中多数类别在过滤后 pass@1 上升，说明无效或含糊题确实会压低可解释性。该证据支持 benchmark 的难度与质量控制，但部分理解任务依赖 LLM judge，不能与编译/仿真通过率视为同等确定。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing datasets such as VerilogEval mainly measure generation of one module from a specification, usually in a single-file, single-turn setting with fixed tests. CVDP changes task coverage and interaction form by placing RTL, testbench, assertions, debugging, QoR improvement, specification correspondence, and question answering in one taxonomy, with both direct-generation and multi-turn agent repositories. The novelty is not the simulator itself, but expert task definition from real workflows and validation that complete contexts are solvable while incomplete contexts should fail.

VerilogEval 等已有数据重点测量由规格生成一个模块，通常是单文件、单轮和固定 testbench。CVDP 改变的是任务覆盖与交互形式：把 RTL、testbench、assertion、调试、QoR 改进、规格对应和问答放入同一分类体系，并同时提供直接生成与多轮 agent 仓库。新意不在使用仿真器，而在由工程师从真实工作流定义问题，并验证“完整上下文可解、残缺上下文应失败”，从而测试模型是否正确利用设计环境。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Sample ceiling: Although broad, 783 tasks leave limited counts per category and reflect workflows familiar to participating organizations. They do not represent every proprietary EDA stack, process, or design rule.
  2. Heterogeneous evaluation: Compilation and simulation, BLEU, and LLM judging have different reliability. One aggregate score hides evidence strength, so results should be reported by task category and verifier type.
  3. Environment drift: Erroneous RTL can generate large logs and resource consumption, and outcomes depend on simulator, timeout, memory, and dependency versions. Reproductions need fixed containers and explicit execution-failure categories.

1. 样本上限：783 项虽覆盖广，但各类别数量有限，且来自参与机构熟悉的流程；不能代表所有公司专用 EDA、工艺和设计规范。
  2. 评测异质性：编译/仿真、BLEU 和 LLM judge 的可靠性不同，合并总分会掩盖证据强度；应按 task category 与 verifier 类型分别报告。
  3. 环境漂移：错误 RTL 可能产生大日志和资源消耗，结果对 simulator、timeout、内存及依赖版本敏感；复现必须使用固定容器并记录执行失败原因。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Hardware-model evaluation: Run models separately on all 13 categories and report pass@1, execution failures, and judge metrics rather than only an aggregate score.
  2. Agent-system diagnosis: In agentic repositories, record file browsing, tool calls, compilation errors, and repair attempts to distinguish planning from RTL ability.
  3. Training-task extraction: Subsets with deterministic references and simulation checks can become SFT or RLVR data, but must be isolated from the official test split and decontaminated by project. If research concerns only simple module completion, CVDP’s broad categories should not be collapsed into one generic code-generation metric.

1. 硬件模型评测：按 13 类分别运行模型，报告 pass@1、执行失败率和 judge 指标，避免只给总分。
  2. 代理系统诊断：在 agentic 仓库中记录文件浏览、工具调用、编译错误和修复次数，区分规划与 RTL 能力。
  3. 训练任务抽取：可将有确定参考和仿真检查的子集转成 SFT 或 RLVR，但应与官方 test split 隔离并按项目去污染。若研究只关注简单模块补全，CVDP 的广泛类别不应被压缩为单一 code-generation 指标。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: It unifies 13 real hardware-design and verification categories into non-agentic and agentic benchmarks.
  2. Method handle: Expert authoring, complete-versus-incomplete context checks, execution filtering, and multi-tool repositories are central.
  3. Data handle: The release contains 783 tasks, with 617 non-agentic and 166 agentic.
  4. Evidence anchor: Frontier-model code pass@1 does not exceed 34%, and about 40.4% of candidates are filtered.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits hardware capability profiling; deterministic execution and LLM-judge results must be reported separately.

1. 一句话定位：它把硬件设计与验证的 13 类真实任务统一成 non-agentic 与 agentic benchmark。
  2. 方法抓手：专家出题、完整/残缺上下文对照、执行过滤和多工具仓库最关键。
  3. 数据抓手：开放 783 项任务，其中 617 项单轮、166 项代理式。
  4. 证据锚点：前沿模型代码任务 pass@1 不超过 34%，候选总体过滤率约 40.4%。
  5. 复用决定：适合硬件能力画像；必须分开报告确定性执行和 LLM judge 结果。
